name: The Customer Service Loadout
tagline: 10 AI staff for customer support, reviews, returns, and retention.
heroHeadline: Stop drowning in customer messages. Start scaling without more staff.
heroSubhead: The complete Claude AI setup for retail owners and e-commerce sellers — beginner-friendly, live in under 30 minutes.
problem: You're answering the same customer questions 20 times a day — shipping, returns, sizing, availability.
Your product listings could convert better, but rewriting them is another thing that never gets done.
Chasing returns, complaints, and restocks leaves no room to actually grow the store.
Bigger brands have customer service teams and marketing departments. You have yourself.
shift: What if customer replies drafted themselves in your brand voice? What if every listing was optimized without you touching it word by word? What if you ran a tighter operation with the same team you have now?

whatsInside.description: Replies to returns, complaints, shipping questions, and reviews — polished and on-brand, ready to send.
Product descriptions, bullet points, and titles optimized for search and for buyers — in minutes, not hours.
Inventory summaries, restock alerts, supplier message drafts — the admin that usually eats your evenings, handled.
Email campaigns, promotional copy, social captions — done in your voice, for your products.

bonuses: Quick-Start Setup Guide (PDF) — running in under 30 minutes, with screenshots

bumpDescription: 20 additional templates for promotional campaigns, influencer outreach, marketplace disputes, refund negotiation, and seasonal sales copy.
premiumDescription: A 30-minute 1-on-1 Zoom call. We install and configure everything together, customized for your store and platform.

faqs.q: Do I need to know anything about AI or coding?
faqs.a: No. Step-by-step setup guide with screenshots. Most users are running in under 30 minutes.

faqs.q: What platforms does this work with?
faqs.a: Claude works in any browser, so it pairs with Shopify, Etsy, Amazon, WooCommerce, or any platform you use.
